name: 33716 · St Petersburg, FL
findings: ZIP 33716 (St Petersburg) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33716 (St Petersburg) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33716 (St Petersburg) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 34% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
